fields.before: A function receives values when it is called, uses them in its processing, and returns the result to the caller. In the pseudo-language it is declared in the form ○整数型: functionName(整数型: name), where 整数型 is the exam notation for integer type, with the return type before the name and the type and name of each received value inside the parentheses after it. Inside the function, return gives back the value written after it and ends the processing.
